plane-northern-continent.name: Northern Continent (Loen Kingdom & Feysac)
plane-northern-continent.description: Heart of human civilization, steam industry, coal smog, and orthodox church power.

plane-mid-seas.name: The Five Seas & Colonial Archipelagos
plane-mid-seas.description: Pirate empires, siren reefs, forbidden cursed islands, and naval fleet battles.

plane-divine-cursed.name: Astral World, Spirit World & Forsaken Land
plane-divine-cursed.description: Domains beyond the curtain: Sefirah Castle above the fog, the dark Forsaken Land of the Gods, and spirit realms.

source.page: Astral World, Spirit World & Forsaken Land

loc-tingan-blackthorn.name: Tingen: Blackthorn Security Co.
loc-tingan-blackthorn.description: Facade for Tingen Nighthawk headquarters, featuring the Chanis Gate and underground ammunition armory.

loc-backlund-borough.name: Backlund: Sherlock Moriarty Agency
loc-backlund-borough.description: Detective office on Minsk Street where Klein solved urban occult mysteries and sheltered allies.

loc-backlund-bridge.name: Backlund Bridge & East District
loc-backlund-bridge.description: Sprawling impoverished slums, coal smog haze, and underground Beyonder ingredient trade markets.

loc-saint-samuel.name: Saint Samuel Cathedral
loc-saint-samuel.description: Gothic cathedral in Backlund housing the highest archbishops and Sacred Emblems of the Evernight Goddess.

loc-queen-square.name: Queen Square & King’s Palace
loc-queen-square.description: Seat of Loen royal governance where George III secretly constructed the altar for the Black Emperor ritual.

loc-backlund-suburbs.name: Maybach Estate (Dwayne Dantès)
loc-backlund-suburbs.description: Aristocratic mansion on Böklund Street where tycoon Dwayne Dantès held high-society banquets.

loc-bayam-archipelago.name: Bayam: City of Generosity
loc-bayam-archipelago.description: Colonial trading metropolis on the Rorsted Archipelago frequented by Gehrman Sparrow and pirate crews.

loc-bansy-harbor.name: Bansy Harbor Ruins
loc-bansy-harbor.description: Desolate port island completely purged by naval lightning bombardment after cannibal rituals were unearthed.

loc-oavi-island.name: Oavi Mermaid Sanctuary
loc-oavi-island.description: Coral waters where mermaids sing enchanting hymns, vital for potion acting and spirit anchoring.

loc-sefirah-castle.name: Above the Gray Fog: Sefirah Castle
loc-sefirah-castle.description: Infinite divine palace of ancient bronze pillars floating above the gray fog; birthplace of the Tarot Club.

source.page: Above the Gray Fog: Sefirah Castle

loc-forsaken-silver.name: City of Silver (Forsaken Land)
loc-forsaken-silver.description: Ancient fortress city surrounded by eternal dark lightning, inhabited by giant cursed descendants.

loc-forsaken-moon.name: Moon City Sanctuary
loc-forsaken-moon.description: Deformed survivors of the cataclysm subsisting on monster flesh, waiting 2,500 years for the savior.

loc-giant-king-court.name: Court of the King of Giants
loc-giant-king-court.description: Titan ruins bathed in eternal sunset glow, guarding the boundary between the dark continent and the sea.

source.page: Court of the King of Giants

loc-calderon-city.name: Calderon Spirit Metropolis
loc-calderon-city.description: Ancient spirit city of Phoenixes and the Underworld, drenched in river waters of the River of Eternal Darkness.

loc-foggy-town.name: Foggy Town (Hornacis Peak)
loc-foggy-town.description: Nightmarish domain of puppets and marionettes under the thrall of the Antigonus family ancestor.

faction-tarot-club.name: The Tarot Club
faction-tarot-club.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by klein-moretti.

faction-nighthawks.name: Church of Evernight (Nighthawks)
faction-nighthawks.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by evernight-goddess.

faction-mandated-punishers.name: Church of Storms (Mandated Punishers)
faction-mandated-punishers.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by lord-of-storms.

faction-machinery-hivemind.name: Church of Steam (Machinery Hivemind)
faction-machinery-hivemind.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by god-of-steam.

faction-aurora-order.name: The Aurora Order
faction-aurora-order.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by adam.

faction-rose-school.name: Rose School of Thought
faction-rose-school.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by sharron.

faction-city-of-silver.name: City of Silver High Council
faction-city-of-silver.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by derrick-berg.

faction-secret-order.name: The Secret Order
faction-secret-order.description: Major occult organization in Lord of the Mysteries led by roselle-gustav.

stage-low-sequence.name: Low-Sequence Beyonder (Seq 9-8)
stage-low-sequence.description: Mortals taking the initial mystical potion; high risk of losing control from digesting improperly.

stage-mid-sequence.name: Mid-Sequence Beyonder (Seq 7-6)
stage-mid-sequence.description: Core magical combatants; requires the Acting Method to assimilate potion principles and maintain sanity.

stage-senior-sequence.name: Senior Sequence (Seq 5)
stage-senior-sequence.description: The threshold before godhood; supreme masters of their respective pathway specialties.

stage-demigod-saint.name: Demigod Saint (Seq 4-3)
stage-demigod-saint.description: Qualitative divine metamorphosis; uncomplete Mythical Creature Form possessing devastating supernatural authority.

stage-angel-archangel.name: Angel / Ground Deity (Seq 2-1)
stage-angel-archangel.description: Kings of Angels and Archangels holding miraculous authority over conceptual reality.

stage-true-deity.name: True Deity (Sequence 0)
stage-true-deity.description: Cosmic God holding the complete Uniqueness of a pathway; immortal anchors required to resist the Oldest One.

stage-above-sequence.name: Above the Sequences / Lord of Mysteries
stage-above-sequence.description: Pillars of the Universe; Great Old Ones commanding multiple neighboring pathways and Sefirot.

source.page: Above the Sequences / Lord of Mysteries

arc-clown.name: Volume 1: Clown
arc-clown.description: Tingen City, joining the Nighthawks, 0-08 conspiracy, Klein’s tragic sacrifice.

arc-faceless.name: Volume 2: Faceless
arc-faceless.description: Sherlock Moriarty in Backlund, fighting Desire Apostles, Great Smog catastrophe.

arc-traveler.name: Volume 3: Traveler
arc-traveler.description: Crazy Adventurer Gehrman Sparrow across the Five Seas, Bansy Harbor, Admiral hunts.

arc-undying.name: Volume 4: Undying
arc-undying.description: Dwayne Dantès, Red Rose Manor, Azik’s past, vengeance against Ince Zangwill.

arc-red-priest.name: Volume 5: Red Priest
arc-red-priest.description: World War erupts, George III Black Emperor ritual, fall of saints.

arc-lightseeker.name: Volume 6: Lightseeker
arc-lightseeker.description: Exploring the Forsaken Land of the Gods, liberating the City of Silver.

arc-the-fool.name: Volume 7: The Fool
arc-the-fool.description: Miracle Invoker ascent, climactic battle against Amon and Zaratul.

arc-fools-gambit.name: Volume 8: Fool’s Gambit
arc-fools-gambit.description: Sefirah Castle awakening, entering slumber to protect humanity against Celestial Worthy.

klein-moretti.name: The Fool / Klein Moretti
aliases: The Fool / Lord of the Mysteries
klein-moretti.description: Transmigrator Zhou Mingrui; Master of the Fool Pathway and Lord of the Mysteries presiding over the Tarot Club.

audrey-hall.name: Audrey Hall
audrey-hall.description: Earl Hall’s daughter; high-sequence Manipulator of the Spectator pathway and core financier of the Tarot Club.

alger-wilson.name: Alger Wilson
alger-wilson.description: Captain of the Blue Avenger; veteran Sailor pathway Beyonder and seafaring tactician for the Tarot Club.

derrick-berg.name: Derrick Berg
derrick-berg.description: Youth of the City of Silver who sought salvation from the endless darkness through Mr. Fool’s grace.

fors-wall.name: Fors Wall
fors-wall.description: Author and Door pathway Beyonder capable of spatial traversal, recording spells, and wandering the cosmos.

xio-derecha.name: Xio Derecha
xio-derecha.description: Fors’s stalwart partner; Arbiter pathway judge enforcing discipline and order in Backlund’s underground.

emlyn-white.name: Emlyn White
emlyn-white.description: Sanguine vampire doll enthusiast who became the devout high-sequence apostle of the Earth Mother.

cattledya.name: Cattledya
cattledya.description: Pirate Admiral of the Future; Mystery Pryer demigod and adoptive disciple of Queen Mystic Bernadette.

leonard-mitchell.name: Leonard Mitchell
leonard-mitchell.description: Poetic Nighthawk who harbors the ancient Marauder Angel Pallez Zoroast within his spirit.

amon.name: Amon
amon.description: Son of the Ancient Sun God; monocle-wearing King of Angels who steals thoughts, abilities, and destiny.

adam.name: Adam
adam.description: Leader of the Twilight Hermit Order; Spectator pathway True God who writes history into inevitable reality.

dunn-smith.name: Dunn Smith
dunn-smith.description: Valiant Captain of the Tingen Nighthawks who laid down his life with a smile to protect his city.

daly-simone.name: Daly Simone
daly-simone.description: Unorthodox spirit medium of the Church of the Evernight Goddess; beloved partner of Captain Dunn Smith.

azik-eggers.name: Azik Eggers
azik-eggers.description: Son of the Death Balam Emperor; ancient amnesiac demigod who served as Klein’s guardian angel.

will-auceptin.name: Will Auceptin
will-auceptin.description: Snake of Fate reincarnated as a baby; loves ice cream and governs probability and karmic luck.

sharron.name: Sharron
sharron.description: Pale doll-like demigod of the Temperance faction; transforms into incorporeal wraiths and mirror reflections.

maric.name: Maric
maric.description: Sharron’s steadfast partner who controls hordes of undead and channels zombie impulses into tarot games.

in-zangwill.name: Ince Zangwill
in-zangwill.description: Traitorous former Archbishop who used Sealed Artifact 0-08 to orchestrate the tragedy of Tingen.

medici.name: Medici
medici.description: Ancient Red Angel evil spirit of the Hunter pathway who provokes nations into catastrophic wars.

ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
ouroboros.description: King of Angels of the Monster pathway; devout attendant to the True Creator who paints destiny murals.

pallez-zoroast.name: Pallez Zoroast
pallez-zoroast.description: Marauder pathway Angel parasitizing Leonard Mitchell; ancient rival of Amon from the Fourth Epoch.

reinette-tinekerr.name: Reinette Tinekerr
reinette-tinekerr.description: Chained pathway Angel appearing as a gothic doll carrying four blonde heads, collecting gold coins for deliveries.

bernadette-gustav.name: Bernadette Gustav
bernadette-gustav.description: Daughter of Emperor Roselle and leader of Element Dawn; master of fairy tale spells and mystical items.

roselle-gustav.name: Roselle Gustav
roselle-gustav.description: Transmigrator emperor of Intis who created steam machinery, the Tarot deck, and the Black Emperor pathway.

evernight-goddess.name: Evernight Goddess
evernight-goddess.description: True Deity of Darkness, Slumber, and Misfortune; ancient Transmigrator protecting humanity’s sanity.

lord-of-storms.name: Lord of Storms
lord-of-storms.description: Deity of Lightning, Wind, and the Berserk Sea; strikes blasphemers down with thunder.

god-of-steam.name: God of Steam and Machinery
god-of-steam.description: Orthodox Deity of Mechanics, Industry, and Physics, patron of the steam revolution.

true-creator.name: The True Creator
true-creator.description: Mad deity worshipped by the Aurora Order; murmuring corrupting ravings into the minds of Beyonders.

ev-tingan-coincidence.name: The Tragedy of Tingen & Sealed Artifact 0-08
ev-tingan-coincidence.description: Captain Dunn Smith sacrifices himself to stop Megose; Klein is slain by Ince Zangwill and revives.

source.page: The Tragedy of Tingen & Sealed Artifact 0-08

ev-tarot-origin.name: Inaugural Tarot Club Gathering
ev-tarot-origin.description: Klein pulls Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man above the Gray Fog to establish the legendary Tarot Club.

ev-great-smog.name: The Great Smog of Backlund
ev-great-smog.description: Desire Apostle and demoness conspiracy unleashes lethal smog across Backlund.

ev-bansy-bombardment.name: Purging of Bansy Harbor
ev-bansy-bombardment.description: Gehrman Sparrow investigates cursed cannibal rituals; the Church of Storms bombards the island with thunder.

ev-ince-slain.name: Vengeance for Dunn: Ince Zangwill Slain
ev-ince-slain.description: Klein and Leonard avenge Captain Dunn Smith and Daly Simone, retrieving Sealed Artifact 0-08.

source.page: Vengeance for Dunn: Ince Zangwill Slain

ev-silver-liberation.name: Liberation of the City of Silver
ev-silver-liberation.description: Derrick Berg and the City of Silver march into the light of the outside world after 2,500 years of darkness.

source.page: Liberation of the City of Silver

ev-amon-duel.name: Battle of the Gods: Klein vs Amon
ev-amon-duel.description: In Sefirah Castle, Klein risks madness by accommodating the Fool Uniqueness to shatter Amon’s avatar and True Body.

source.page: Battle of the Gods: Klein vs Amon

ev-fools-slumber.name: Mr. Fool Enters Eternal Slumber
ev-fools-slumber.description: Klein falls into slumber to wage cosmic psychological warfare against the awakening Celestial Worthy.

pathway-fool.name: Fool Pathway (Seer)
pathway-fool.description: Governed by Sefirah Castle. Specializes in divination, marionette soul threads, historical void projections, miracle invocation, and grafting reality.

pathway-door.name: Door Pathway (Apprentice)
pathway-door.description: Governed by Sefirah Castle. Specializes in spatial traversal, recording and casting external abilities, seal breaking, and cosmos exploration.

pathway-error.name: Error Pathway (Marauder)
pathway-error.description: Governed by Sefirah Castle. Specializes in stealing thoughts, abilities, fate, and time; creating parasitism avatars through Worms of Time.

pathway-visionary.name: Visionary Pathway (Spectator)
pathway-visionary.description: Governed by Chaos Sea. Specializes in observing subconscious psychological trends, telepathic manipulation, placation, and authoring real history.

pathway-sun.name: Sun Pathway (Bard)
pathway-sun.description: Governed by Chaos Sea. Specializes in absolute divine purification, banishing unholy spirits, notarizing contracts, and holy light shields.

pathway-tyrant.name: Tyrant Pathway (Sailor)
pathway-tyrant.description: Governed by Chaos Sea. Specializes in aquatic dominance, acoustic sirens, catastrophic tempest summoning, and heavenly thunderbolts.

pathway-white-tower.name: White Tower Pathway (Reader)
pathway-white-tower.description: Governed by Chaos Sea. Specializes in omniscience, rapid deciphering of mysticism secrets, analyzing weaknesses, and replicating spellcraft.

pathway-hanged-man.name: Hanged Man Pathway (Secrets Suppliant)
pathway-hanged-man.description: Governed by Chaos Sea. Specializes in flesh and blood sacrifice, hearing cosmic ravings, shadow corruption, and grazing souls via Shepherd.

pathway-darkness.name: Darkness Pathway (Sleepless)
pathway-darkness.description: Governed by River of Eternal Darkness. Specializes in vigilance, nightmare induction, pacifying spirits, and conceptual concealment of truth.

pathway-death.name: Death Pathway (Corpse Collector)
pathway-death.description: Governed by River of Eternal Darkness. Specializes in spirit summoning, death manipulation, immunity to fatal wounds, and reincarnation through the River.

pathway-twilight-giant.name: Twilight Giant Pathway (Warrior)
pathway-twilight-giant.description: Governed by River of Eternal Darkness. Specializes in peerless martial weapon mastery, impenetrable twilight armor, and decay of divine constructs.

pathway-red-priest.name: Red Priest Pathway (Hunter)
pathway-red-priest.description: Governed by City of Calamity. Specializes in provoker psychological agitation, pyromancy, army vanguard buffs, and continental-scale military warfare.

pathway-demoness.name: Demoness Pathway (Assassin)
pathway-demoness.description: Governed by City of Calamity. Specializes in stealth assassinations, seductive allure, black flame curses, disease spread, and cataclysmic disasters.

pathway-hermit.name: Hermit Pathway (Mystery Pryer)
pathway-hermit.description: Governed by Knowledge Moor. Specializes in mysticism scroll infusion, astronomical divination, fairytales invocation, and comprehension of hidden symbols.

pathway-paragon.name: Paragon Pathway (Savant)
pathway-paragon.description: Governed by Knowledge Moor. Specializes in technological alchemy, steam machinery, discovering material essences, and constructing mystical artifacts.

pathway-wheel-of-fortune.name: Wheel of Fortune Pathway (Monster)
pathway-wheel-of-fortune.description: Governed by Key of Light. Specializes in perceiving spiritual luck currents, manipulating probability, premonitions of danger, and fate reboots.

pathway-moon.name: Moon Pathway (Apothecary)
pathway-moon.description: Governed by Brood Hive. Specializes in herbal potion concoctions, vampire blood transformations, beast taming, and crimson moon divine blessings.

pathway-mother.name: Mother Pathway (Planter)
pathway-mother.description: Governed by Brood Hive. Specializes in botanical hybridization, healing wounds, biological flesh creation, and fostering planetary fertility.

pathway-chained.name: Chained Pathway (Prisoner)
pathway-chained.description: Governed by Tenebrous World. Specializes in ascetic restraint, werewolf physical metamorphosis, ethereal wraith possession, and malevolent voodoo dolls.

pathway-abyss.name: Abyss Pathway (Criminal)
pathway-abyss.description: Governed by Tenebrous World. Specializes in malice premonition, sulfur flames, devil physical enhancements, blood contracts, and serial depravity.

pathway-black-emperor.name: Black Emperor Pathway (Lawyer)
pathway-black-emperor.description: Governed by Nation of Disorder. Specializes in exploiting systemic loopholes, bribery, psychological corruption, and distorting physical and legal rules.

pathway-justiciar.name: Justiciar Pathway (Arbiter)
pathway-justiciar.description: Governed by Nation of Disorder. Specializes in natural authority intimidation, enforcing mandatory prohibitions, sentencing criminals, and sealing zones.

rel-klein-moretti-alger-wilson.label: Tarot Club Convenor & Mr. Hanged Man

rel-klein-moretti-leonard-mitchell.label: Tarot Club Convenor & Former Nighthawk Comrade

rel-amon-adam.label: Sons of the Ancient Sun God
